mapper.select: SELECT FROM gamification_runtime_config WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM gamification_runtime_config WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM gamification_runtime_config WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

mapper.update: UPDATE gamification_runtime_config SET policy_version = #{row.policyVersion}, zone_id = #{row.zoneId}, event_enabled = #{row.eventEnabled}, event_drain_batch_size = #{row.eventDrainBatchSize}, event_drain_delay_ms = #{row.eventDrainDelayMs}, event_max_attempt = #{row.eventMaxAttempt}, ticket_enabled = #{row.ticketEnabled}, ticket_lot_validity_days = #{row.ticketLotValidityDays}, ticket_expiry_cron = #{row.ticketExpiryCron}, ticket_expiry_batch_size = #{row.ticketExpiryBatchSize}, ticket_max_grant_per_batch = #{row.ticketMaxGrantPerBatch}, vote_enabled = #{row.voteEnabled}, vote_allow_crawled_books = #{row.voteAllowCrawledBooks}, vote_ip_hash_key_id = #{row.voteIpHashKeyId}, vote_max_tickets_per_request = #{row.voteMaxTicketsPerRequest}, vote_max_votes_per_day = #{row.voteMaxVotesPerDay}, vote_max_tickets_per_day = #{row.voteMaxTicketsPerDay}, vote_max_tickets_per_book_season = #{row.voteMaxTicketsPerBookPerSeason}, vote_max_lots_per_spend = #{row.voteMaxLotsPerSpend}, quest_enabled = #{row.questEnabled}, quest_heartbeat_interval_seconds = #{row.questHeartbeatIntervalSeconds}, quest_heartbeat_max_minutes_day = #{row.questHeartbeatMaxMinutesPerDay}, realm_enabled = #{row.realmEnabled}, realm_change_cooldown_hours = #{row.realmChangeCooldownHours}, season_enabled = #{row.seasonEnabled}, season_close_cron = #{row.seasonCloseCron}, season_close_drain_seconds = #{row.seasonCloseDrainSeconds}, season_resume_delay_ms = #{row.seasonResumeDelayMs}, season_review_window_hours = #{row.seasonReviewWindowHours}, reward_enabled = #{row.rewardEnabled}, reward_claim_window_days = #{row.rewardClaimWindowDays}, reward_release_cron = #{row.rewardReleaseCron}, job_lease_seconds = #{row.jobLeaseSeconds}, job_batch_size = #{row.jobBatchSize}, config_hash = #{row.configHash}, change_reason = #{row.changeReason}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{row.id} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE gamification_runtime_config SET status = 'APPROVED', approved_by = #{operatorId}, approved_at = #{approvedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING_APPROVAL' AND version = #{expectedVersion}
